Definition: DaTscan - Left Caudate refers to the striatal binding ratio (SBR) measured in the left caudate region of interest during a dopamine transporter (DaT) scan. The SBR is calculated by comparing the radiotracer uptake in the left caudate to that in the occipital lobe, which serves as a reference region with minimal DaT expression.
